fundamental.summary: AMD shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 75 days.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity from junior member with no clear directional bias; broad market sentiment neutral with no contrarian opportunity or warning signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (265.28) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 75 days adds event risk; only falling DXY provides modest relief for multinational AMD.
